reputation.summary: The reference ultralow-noise op-amp for MC phono, tape heads and dynamic mics. A diyAudio poster calls it 'the only real L.T. star'; Audio Asylum weighs it against the AD797. Popular for Xonar ST/STX I/V rolling; Japanese Dr.DAC users call it monitor-like. The 1993 rec.audio FAQ: 'very well received'. Engineers note high current noise and a 400 kHz noise bump.
typical_uses: DAC I/V and op-amp rolling (Xonar ST/STX, Dr.DAC)
Low-noise measurement preamps, TIAs, laser drivers
caveats: LT1028 needs gain ≥+2 or −1; may oscillate as a follower or with a large I/V feedback cap. Use LT1128.
High bias (±25 nA) and current noise: above ~1 kΩ (~400 Ω at 10 Hz) pick another part; match sources.
Draws 7.4 mA typ (to 12.5 mA max); runs warm. Specified at ±15 V.
Single only; pin 5 is over-compensation, pins 1/8 VOS trim; SW16 has a different pinout.
Input diodes lack series resistors; limit current to 25 mA. A 400 kHz noise bump raises wideband noise.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit reports; bulk eBay lots are a red flag. SO-8 marks '1028'/'1128'; PDIP/SW16 show the full number. AM/M, TO-5, CERDIP are obsolete. Check ~7.4 mA supply current and ≤1.2 nV/√Hz noise; a fake usually shows ~3 nV/√Hz.
alternatives: AD797 (0.9 nV/√Hz, usual MC phono rival)

silicon_changes.identification: Older SO-8 parts have an ink top mark, newer ones a laser mark; text still reads '1028'.
silicon_changes.summary: Marking only: laser mark allowed as an alternative to the ink top mark on legacy Linear box-stock devices. No die change.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low - marking change only; same die and package.
silicon_changes.verification: Rev B affected-models appendix lists LT1028CS8 variants; Rev - describes the change. PDF not read in full.

silicon_changes.identification: Ink versus laser top mark on PDIP and wide-SOIC parts; both genuine.
silicon_changes.summary: Marking only: top mark converted from ink to laser on legacy Linear PDIP (22_0172) and SOIC_W (22_0176, ADPG/UTL assembly) products. PCN 22_0176 published 2022-08-10, effective 2022-11-12; no form, fit, function or reliability impact.
silicon_changes.verification: Affected-model appendices list the LT1028 parts; PCN 22_0172 date and scope seen only in fragments.

silicon_changes.identification: By date code only: parts coded 2242 or later use the new epoxy (rollout to DC2317). No visible difference.
silicon_changes.summary: Die-attach epoxy changed from Henkel 8290 to 8290A, which ADI calls more robust with less outgassing. No impact to fit, form or function. Die unchanged.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low - qualified assembly material change; same die.
silicon_changes.verification: Affected-model appendices list LT1028 parts; epoxy and date-code details from PCN text excerpts.

silicon_changes.identification: Older parts carry the trace code on the package bottom, newer ones in the top-side laser mark.
silicon_changes.summary: Marking only: bottom-side trace code moved into the top-side mark (companion of PCN 24_0234). No form, fit or function impact.
silicon_changes.verification: Search excerpt lists LT1028CS8 variants in the affected-models appendix; PDF not read.

silicon_changes.identification: Leaded (non-#PBF) SO-8 codes only; LT1028CS8#PBF and #TRPBF are the named pin-to-pin replacements.
silicon_changes.summary: Discontinuance of the leaded SO-8 ordering codes; the lead-free versions of the same part continue.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low - same part in lead-free finish.
silicon_changes.verification: PDN appendix lists the codes and replacements; notice date not seen.

claims_confirmed: ADI hosts Linear-branded 1028fd (Rev D); no Rev E / 1028fe found (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/1028fd.pdf).
Rev D header reads 'For more information www.linear.com/LT1028' (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/1028fd.pdf).
ADI LT1028 product page is live (https://www.analog.com/en/products/lt1028.html).
ADI LT1128 product page is live (https://www.analog.com/en/products/lt1128.html).
Radiolocman mirror 'Datasheet LT1028, LT1128 Analog Devices' shows '(OBSOLETE)' and 'OBSOLETE PACKAGE' headings (https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/pdf.html?di=151183&p=1).
Datasheet carries 'NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW DESIGNS' and lists LT1028CSW and LT1028ACN8 (https://manuals.plus/m/f169c6d63a3f76e698b4d60473eec520987f981e7489c35cb3a5f8b3bc2e81fa).
Octopart lists LT1028ACN8#PBF as 'Production' (https://octopart.com/part/analog-devices/LT1028ACN8%23PBF).
DigiKey has a live LT1028ACN8#PBF listing (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/analog-devices-inc/LT1028ACN8-PBF/894417).
Rev C copy titled '1028fc' is on Scribd (https://www.scribd.com/document/267915717/1028fc).
Linear-branded alldatasheet copy is 20 pages / 439 KB, older than 28-page Rev D (https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/70264/LINER/LT1028.html).
0.85 nV/√Hz; GBW 50 / 13 MHz min; SR 11 / 5 V/µs min (https://www.scribd.com/document/267915717/1028fc).
diyAudio poster: 'the only real L.T. star' (https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/the-best-sounding-audio-integrated-opamps.154106/page-41).
Widely used in DIY MC/MM RIAA stages (https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/riaa-stage-based-on-lt1028.251875/).
Weighed against AD797 for MC phono (https://www.audioasylum.com/cgi/t.mpl?f=tweaks&m=82848).
Sold as a single DIP-8 unit for rolling (https://www.audiophonics.fr/en/opa/lt1028-single-opa-dip8-unit-p-16918.html).
Marutsu mirror of the LT1028/LT1128 datasheet exists (https://www.marutsu.co.jp/contents/shop/marutsu/datasheet/LT1028.pdf).
No TI second-source LT1028 datasheet or SLOS number found (https://datasheetarchive.com/LT1028-datasheet.html).
PCN 21_0060 Rev B lists LT1028CS8 variants; laser mark allowed instead of ink from WW44 2021 (https://www-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_21_0060_Rev_B_Form.pdf).
PCN 22_0172 (PDIP laser mark) lists LT1028CN8 and LT1028CN8#PBF (https://wcm-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_22_0172_Rev_-_Form.pdf).
PCN 22_0176: ink-to-laser top mark on SOIC_W, published 2022-08-10, lists LT1028CSW#PBF/#TRPBF (https://wcm-cce.cldnet.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_22_0176_Rev_-_Form.pdf).
PCN 22_0241 lists LT1028ACN8#PBF, LT1028CN8, LT1028CN8#PBF; Henkel 8290 to 8290A from DC2242 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_22_0241_Rev_A_Form.pdf).
PCN 22_0254 (Henkel 8290 to 8290A epoxy) lists LT1028CS8 variants (https://www.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_22_0254_Rev_A_Form.pdf).
PDN 25_0027 discontinues LT1028CS8 and LT1028CS8#TR; #PBF/#TRPBF are replacements (https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/7121/ADI_PDN_25_0027_Rev_-_Form.pdf).
Radiolocman LT1028/LT1128 copy carries the 1028fd footer, 28 pages (https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/pdf.html?di=151183&p=1).
